description: This IIASA archive supplies input data for Community Water Model version 1.04 at half-degree resolution. It contains global land-cover, soil, groundwater and routing parameters, with lake and reservoir attributes. A Rhine catchment example supplies daily precipitation, temperature and potential evaporation from 1961 to 2010 in NetCDF files. The broader forcing source spans a longer period, but that is not the period of the packaged Rhine subset. The archive is publicly available as a ZIP, and DataCite explicitly records GPL-3.0-or-later and open access even though the retrieved Zenodo licence field was empty. The data can parameterize water-supply, irrigation and hydrological simulations using existing model-iiasa-cwatm-community-water-model. A limitation is its version-specific layout and coarse spatial resolution; file paths in the supplied run scripts and configuration may need adjustment. The provider describes how to launch the Rhine example. No archive contents were downloaded or model runs attempted.
